metadata.change_reason: Complex feature implementation quality standard: Actionable algorithm pseudocode, time/space complexity, and timeboxed spike plans

rules.statement: High-risk or high-complexity features must provide detailed algorithm pseudocode along with explicit time and space complexity analysis
For modules with technical uncertainty, must provide timeboxed Spike validation plans with definitive acceptance criteria
Leaving blank sections or using TODO/TBD placeholders in algorithms and implementation details is strictly prohibited
